the smallest detected lead value is at least 0.010 ppm in each of 2018, 2019, 2020 and 2021 (graded on the years that pass)
FDA dry-infant-cereal action level (0.020 ppm): at least 6 of the 48 2019 infant cereals and 1 to 3 of the 39 2022 infant cereals are above it
each printed mean is reproduced by the predicted convention: all-sample in 2017, 2019, 2020 and 2021; positives-only in 2018 and 2022
infant cereal at a common 0.015 ppm cut: the 2022 rate is below the 2019 rate (point estimates; Fisher p and Wilson intervals reported)
